svg.text: A · Pay run — draft, and offline
You’re offline — generating and finalising are disabled until you reconnect.
Employer (13%, paid by CLCD — not deducted from you)
NHIL (2.5%) is an employer levy in Ghana.
It is reported as an employer cost, never as your deduction.
This pay run is finalised and locked. Generate, Adjust and Delete are gone — not disabled.
Every figure is produced by a pure calculation module that was tested against known-good sample employees before it
was wired to a screen. The run pins its rates version, so a payslip issued today still reconciles after the bands move.
A payslip that shows its working. The band table is
not decoration: it is how a non-specialist checks the
number, and how an employee can see it is right.
